label: Real-driving emissions conformity
definition: In-service and PEMS testing of real-world NOx rather than type-approval Euro label
citation: O'Driscoll 2018 (10.1016/j.scitotenv.2017.11.271) shows Euro 6 diesel urban NOx 11 times gasoline so Euro label alone is arbitrary, GSO 2025 sets UAE RDE from 2030 MY

label: School bus fleet clean technology
definition: Fuel and aftertreatment standard of the school bus fleet (ULSD DOC CCV electric) as distinct from bus provision
citation: Adar 2015 (10.1164/rccm.201410-1924OC) 10 to 50% lower in-bus PM and 8% lower absenteeism, Bursey 2025 (10.1016/j.scitotenv.2025.179843)

label: Fleet non-compliance share
definition: Fraction of vehicles on the road below the current emission standard
citation: Tong 2025 (10.1038/s44407-025-00030-9) 39% non-compliant before ULEZ1 drives the size of the LEZ effect

label: Demand-side management programme
definition: Emirate-level electricity and water demand reduction programme with measured savings
citation: Abu Dhabi DoE DSM Strategy 2030, 8,532 GWh (9.99%) saved to 2023 against a 22% target, 4.3 Mt CO2 avoided
